description: S31 D8: a write-shaped `step.tool.end` carries the line-diff counts against the previous content — `{stepId, tool, toolUseId, path, linesAdded, linesRemoved}` — so the ladder and the chat screen answer "what did that call cost the file" without re-reading anything. The tool's model-facing content is untouched (N5: the counts ride the EVENT, never the transcript); a tool that never ran publishes no tool.end at all (the steered skip speaks through `step.tool.skipped`), and non-file tools leave these fields absent.
